description: This map displays a segment of False-Colour Infrared (FCIR) satellite imagery. A blue polygonal outline delineates a specific land cover unit. The area within the blue polygon is characterized by a lighter, mottled texture, showing patches of light grey/white and sparse reddish/brownish elements. The surrounding areas, outside the blue polygon, exhibit a darker red tone, indicative of denser, healthier vegetation in FCIR. Based on the surrounding document context, the area highlighted by the blue polygon represents Mediterranean pseudo-steppes, likely depicted in summertime. No geographic labels, scale bar, compass, or legend are visible in the image.
